## What does this change?

A sentence or two that someone who doesn't code could follow.

## Why?

The problem it solves. Link the issue if there is one, like `Closes #123`.

## What kind of change is it?

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or tool
- [ ] Improvement to something that exists
- [ ] Docs only
- [ ] Other:

## How did you check it?

What you ran or clicked, and on which system (Windows 11, macOS, ...).

## Screenshots

For anything you can see on the page. Before and after helps. Check no cookie shows.

## Checklist

- [ ] Every tool still runs from the command line, not just the web page.
- [ ] Python changes still run on Python 3.8 (`vermin -t=3.8- --violations <file>`).
- [ ] The web page type checks (`cd ui && npm run typecheck`).
- [ ] Page changes look right on a phone and a large screen.
- [ ] New settings are in `.env.example`, on the Settings page and in the docs.
- [ ] Anything new sent over the network or saved to disk is in the Privacy Policy.
- [ ] New source files start with the license header.
- [ ] No cookie, `.env` content or personal details in the code, screenshots or logs.
